answer_1.quote: Despite these overwhelming attempts, the natural language generation (NLG) and evaluation of the code-mixed data remain understudied.

answer_2.quote: We use the following three evaluation metrics: • F1-score (FS): We use the weighted F1-score to evaluate the system performance. • Cohen's Kappa (CK): We use the Cohen's Kappa score to measure the agreement between the predicted and the actual rating. • Mean Squared Error (MSE): MSE suggests the difference between the actual and the predicted scores.

answer_4.quote: We employ eight human annotators to provide a rating between 1 (low quality) to 10 (high quality) to the generated Hinglish sentences.
answer_4.guideline: The rating depends on the following three factors: 1. The similarity between the generated Hinglish sentence and the source sentences. 2. The readability of the generated sentence. 3. The grammatical correctness of the generated sentence.
